text:
lucy: Quick sync  Optimize toolkit priorities for next sprint. Two clear customer asks: eval-triggered regression alerts (PD + Console) and a tiny mobile batching helper (JS/Kotlin). I propose we ship: 1) alert plumbing + PD/Slack hooks + 3 starter templates, 2) batching helper + docs/snippets. Defer quant recommendations to post-beta. Agree?

omar: +1. Narrow slice is key. Alerts should be eval-delta first (quality), not cost/latency day 1.

tara: ML will supply templates (concordance_delta, auc_drop, failure_rate) and a small eval pack for validation. Rule sketch: if baseline - current > 0.05 AND sample_count >= 30 -> alert, attach top_10 failing prompts.

devin: Infra needs per-tenant metric buckets, durable alert queue, a canary toggle to enable alerts for internal+2 betas, and a webhook test endpoint for PD/Slack. ETA ~3 weeks if templates and API shape freeze.

irene: CS will collect PD webhook details and Zephyr's connectivity traces for batching snippet verification. Also request quiet-hours support for PD.

lucy: Proposed acceptance gates: alerts trigger on internal eval suite with reproducible samples; PD + Console delivery validated for 2 betas; batching helper + JS/Kotlin snippets in docs; beta runbook + oncall owner assigned. Target beta in ~5 weeks.

omar: UI plan: simple template picker (3 templates) + numeric threshold + tenant enable toggle. Inbox shows trigger reason + sample payload. Need an API: /alerts/eval-diff?tenant=...

tara: I'll freeze templates by Mon and attach eval pack.

devin: I'll add canary flag, alert queue, and webhook tester. Will also emit alert_delivery_latency_ms metric.

irene: I'll produce the beta onboarding checklist and PD runbook fragment.

scheduler-bot: Meeting scheduled: "Optimize toolkit - scope sync" on 2025-04-28 10:00 PT. Invited: lucy, omar, tara, devin, irene.

lucy: Thanks team. Keep scope tight; call out any proposed scope creep (quant recs, full rule-builder, cost alarms) now or we'll defer.
